route_debrief: Open-jaw West Europe (45 days max): land EDI → Scotland car loop (Edinburgh, Fife, Dundee, Perth) → drop the rental at EDI → ScotRail to Glasgow → Northern/Central England → London hub → SW England & Wales → Ireland loop → Northern France & Paris → Brittany & SW France → Basque / Northern Spain → Central & Southern Spain → Portugal → fly home from Lisbon or Porto. Day budget: UK 11 / Ireland 6 / France 10 / Spain 10 / Portugal 8.

legs.name: Scotland car loop (Dundee)
legs.blurb: Land EDI, Edinburgh cluster, pick up the car, Forth Bridge / Eagle Rock / St Andrews, overnight Dundee. Day 2: Perth / Scone / Almondbank, then return the car at EDI.

legs.name: Glasgow
legs.blurb: Evening train from EDI into Glasgow; full day in the city without a car.

legs.name: Northern/Central England
legs.blurb: York, Manchester, Birmingham and other North/Midlands pin clusters between Glasgow and London.

legs.name: London Hub
legs.blurb: Dense London / West End / riverside pins — museums, food, and day trips like Windsor or Canterbury.

legs.name: SW England & Wales
legs.blurb: Tintagel, Tank Museum / Bovington, and Welsh stops before crossing to Ireland.

legs.name: Ireland Loop
legs.blurb: Dublin hub plus west and midlands pins (Clifden, Newgrange area, Cork/Kerry approaches).

legs.name: Northern France & Paris
legs.blurb: Paris and northern France (Reims, Amiens, Channel approaches) after Ireland.

legs.name: Brittany & SW France
legs.blurb: Brittany (Rennes / Quintin / Carnac) and Atlantic / SW France (Bordeaux, Cognac, Lyon approaches).

legs.name: Northern Spain / Basque
legs.blurb: San Sebastián / Basque coast, then northwest Spain (Potes, Galicia / Fisterra).

legs.name: Central & Southern Spain
legs.blurb: Madrid, Toledo, Andalusia (Granada, Marbella, Tarifa) and related inland pins.

legs.name: Portugal
legs.blurb: Lisbon neighborhoods, Sintra / Cape Roca, Porto and Douro — open-jaw home from Lisbon or Porto.
